title: Calibration Department Points Table for the Rental Vehicle Coordination Repair-Customer Discount
content:
**Points table.** The calibration points of the repair-customer discount credit on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair are percentage points added to the credit's discount rate, and depend on the calibration order opened for the repair under ADAS Sensor Calibrations: where its in-house attempts failed and it was sublet to a dealer, they are 5 points; where an in-house attempt failed and the order did not go to a dealer, they are 2 points; otherwise they are zero.

## Records read

The calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the customer-pay repair order, its dealer sublet date, and its in-house calibration attempts with their results.

## Points by combination

| At least one in-house attempt failed | Order sublet to a dealer | Calibration points |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 5 |
| Yes | No | 2 |
| No | Yes | 0 |
| No | No | 0 |
| No calibration order for the repair | | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A calibration order with one failed attempt, a passing second attempt and no sublet: 2 points.
- A calibration order with two failed attempts, then sublet to a dealer: 5 points.
- A calibration order sublet to a dealer without any failed in-house attempt: no points.
